Our Vision

A crest built on light, learning and growth.

Our emblem tells the story we try to live out every day: a sunrise breaking over an open book, held up by branches of wheat on either side. It's simple, and it's deliberate.

  • ☀️The rising sun — a new beginning for every child who walks through our gates, every single morning.
  • 📖The open book — knowledge offered freely, without walls, to every student who reaches for it.
  • 🌾The wheat branches — the prosperity and growth we hope our students carry back to their families.
Why Families Choose Us

Built on ground you can see for yourself.

No two schools look alike, and neither do their values. Here's what stands out when you visit our Babuan‑5 campus.

01

Every Morning, Together

Our full student body lines up for assembly in the open courtyard — rain or shine, discipline starts at 8 AM.

03

National Pride, Genuinely Marked

From Independence Day to Republic Day, our staff and students mark national occasions with real ceremony, not just a holiday.

04

A Close-Knit Staff
